newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates steady between 21 and 21.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates steady between 21 and 21.25 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates moved in a narrow range between 21 and 21.25 percent on Wednesday, at the same levels where they traded on Tuesday, dealers said.
The overnight rates finished at 21.125 percent.

Dealers said trading was slightly less busy than earlier this week as some large banks placed funds into one-month reverse repo deals since last Friday, when some 70 billion forints from matured government bonds hit the market.

"That money disappeared soon enough," said Sandor tolonics of Commerzbank. "Partly the April 20 tax-payment may have caused it and I think some large banks have put money in the one-month reverse repo at 21.5 percent."

Dealers said expectations for a small repo cut, probably for the one-month maturity, may have also encouraged some banks to use the National Bank of Hungary's reverse repo facilities, but these expectations were not very strong.
The overnight rates were seen remaining close to the current levels and above 21 percent until the end of the reserve period at end-April.
